title: Mitosis OS-process SPEC implementation: the eighteen-MSP stack

completion_criteria.text: The SPEC's admission gate is green before any MSP is cut: every path:line citation in it re-verified against the current tree, with drift corrected.
The A4 Workflow schema question is answered against the live tool path, and if schema enforcement proves already void on main, that defect is fixed and shipped before the rest of the stack.
The scalar fileScope fail-open ships to main as a standalone PR, with planWaves and derive-edges both proven to fail closed and an acceptance test red on the parent commit.
The pathsOverlap glob and canonicalization fail-open ships to main as its own PR, with an acceptance test red on the parent commit and the fix mirrored into the workflows copy in the same commit.
The pre-existing derive-edges defect that wipes edgeReasons on an in-place re-run is fixed and lands on the stack base, with an acceptance test red on the parent commit.
All eighteen MSPs land as stacked PRs on base feat/mitosis-os-process, each independently green (node --test, lints, every gate verb at that commit), with nothing merged to main.
The three structural guarantees each ship a red case proving the gate catches its own violation: exec-allowlist, determinism, dispatchable-agent-schema-capable.
The two deferred classifications close in their named MSPs: redispatch given a determinate home in C7, the three hybrid b2 sites decided per-site in C4, each recorded in its PR body.
D3 publishes the measured comparison against the pre-move baseline, cold and warm cache reported separately, with every cost claim paired with a fixed quality assertion.
The release gate resolves explicitly: base merges to main only if D3 clears the 10-dispatch-per-shipped-MSP falsifier; a failure is recorded as falsified, never quietly merged.

spine.active_goal: Land the eighteen MSPs as stacked PRs on feat/mitosis-os-process; A0, A1, A2, A3 and B1 are in, and A4 and B2 are the next unblocked pair.

spine.last_session: Shipped A2, A3 and B1 via a Workflow script (PRs #74, #75, #73), fixed #73's Semgrep failure, split the 844-line run-store suite, and re-landed the derive-edges fix as #77 after #76 silently merged into an already-merged base.

open_risks.text: Build A4's red case through the claude -p CLI path and assert the SILENT failure — the Workflow agent path auto-grants StructuredOutput, so a red case dispatched through it passes unconditionally and is a guarantee that cannot fail

Delete the five merged MSP branches before cutting new work, and never merge feat/b1-coupling-review — GitHub retargets a stacked PR only when its base branch is deleted, and that surviving branch also duplicates the payload PR #77 already landed

Clear A1's deferred style debt in its own commit — runChild is 185 lines with six nesting levels and holds every termination invariant, and the debt has since grown, with run-store.mjs at 625 lines and pool.test.mjs at 749

B1's verdict gate is armed at the derive-edges entrypoint but not end to end — mitosis.js Parallelize builds its task map from graph.tasks and never reads graph.coupling, so a real run still co-schedules a serialize-defaulted pair with no verdict rendered

The pool refuses per-node cwd and worktree outright rather than confining them — a later MSP that needs genuine per-node working directories has to build that confinement check then, because the allowlist defers the problem rather than solving it

SPEC line 328 still names tests/run-store.test.mjs, which no longer exists — the suite split into four files plus a fixtures module, so A3's Files line is stale prose that no gate reads and no grep will find
Leave the committed RECEIPTS_ACK in A1's test file alone — removing it would exercise the exact old_string hole reported upstream, turning a disclosed escape back into a silent one
Treat A1's twelve inertness mutations as unproven — they are author-reported and were never independently re-run, unlike the suite and gate results which were

Dispatch every child with run_in_background false and re-verify against git when it returns — a background child returns only an id, so a dispatching agent ends its turn narrating that it is holding while nothing ran

Mutate by simulating the plausible unsafe rewrite, never by deleting a guard — generic deletion passed A0's two depth fixes while proving nothing, whereas the rewrite simulation reddened exactly the right tests and nothing else

Every new lib module needs a MIRROR_CENSUS row and a live caller per 0386 — parallel MSPs adding rows always conflict on that one literal, and the resolution is to keep both rows in sorted order, never to drop one
Mirror any change to a twinned lib module into the workflows copy in the same commit — mirror-guard compares normalized source text and reddens on a one-sided edit

Recompute D2's test-count acceptance figure and state the counting unit before D2 is cut — the SPEC claims 35, but the files carry 51 test declarations and 175 runtime cases, so no convention yields 35
Cite mitosis.js for behaviour, never lib/mitosis/*.mjs — mitosis.js has zero imports and calls its own inlined twins, so a lib citation describes a mirror rather than the path that executes

Pair every cost hypothesis with a fixed quality assertion — the instrument counts tokens and cannot see whether a re-architected Decompose cuts worse, so a token win carrying a quality regression will read as a success
Re-cut any MSP that cannot be proven by its own tests — eighteen PRs where nothing runs end to end until C7 is a big-bang in disguise unless each one is genuinely green alone

Expect C7 to exceed the review-size target and budget for it — the tick loop is one unit and cannot be split; this is a named exception in the SPEC, not an oversight to be fixed by splitting it anyway
Copy no fanout source into this repo — it is PolyForm Noncommercial, so the architecture may be adopted and cited as prior art but a verbatim lift is a licensing decision, not a coding one
Work in a worktree under .claude/worktrees/ rather than switching the primary checkout — live config entries resolve into the release rather than the working tree; read other branches with git show

key_decisions.title: The approved MSP stack, A0 through D3
The SPEC is approved and implementation moves to this thread
The two unclassifiable dispatch sites are forced to a decision in their own MSP
Mitosis is prohibited as the engine of its own replacement; the stack ships by plain subagent dispatch
c2 settled by probe: Workflow auto-grants, so A4 defends a migration hazard not a live defect
SPEC acceptance lists are a floor, and inertness mutations simulate the unsafe rewrite
Scalar fileScope fail-open is fixed on main as a standalone PR, not inserted into the stack
pathsOverlap may over-report overlap and must never under-report
The G11 ack erasure is accepted, recorded in two places, and filed upstream
A truncated dispatch payload fails closed, and runChild's refactor is deferred
A deterministic Workflow script drives each MSP lane, replacing the nested orchestrator subagent
A new standalone lib module earns dead-export liveness by a real CLI in its own file, never by a wider surface

out_of_scope: Re-litigating the SPEC's design, which the predecessor thread locked; requirements come from the SPEC and its decision records
SPEC A and the config staging and promotion machinery it shipped
The fix pipeline, excluded by the user from both SPECs
pillars.md, which stays a guiding-principles document carrying no measurements
The deferred supervisor, rotation and spawn-cost research, which returns only after the engine update
